apply_slice_to_dataframe: apply a Python slice object to a Polars DataFrame with full support for negative indexing and stride
apply_slice_to_series: apply a Python slice object to a Polars Series with full support for negative indexing and stride
apply_slice_to_lazyframe: apply a Python slice object to a Polars LazyFrame using efficient lazy computation paths
slice_with_negative_stride: slice a Polars object with negative stride to reverse and sample elements
slice_with_gather_every: slice a Polars object using gather_every for efficient strided access
